baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collective noun قَوْمَ and the emphatic إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا هُمْ carry the paired elatives أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse diagnoses a corporate order on two axes: it withholds what is due, and it crosses the boundary that should contain its power. The repeated pronoun makes the people themselves, not an accidental episode, the bearer of this coupled pattern.

activation_trace.role: The human group image supplies the corporate bearer of the two superlative predicates.
Withholding and confinement of a right gives أَظْلَمَ an inward, deprivation-producing function.
Overstepping the bound in rebellion gives أَطْغَىٰ its outward, limit-crossing function.
The second mapped root independently preserves exceeded measure and allows the boundary mechanism to remain live across the split mapping.

changed_reading.before: Noah's people are cited as an exceptionally wicked population.
changed_reading.after: Noah's people exemplify a self-reinforcing social regime: rights are held back within it while power spills beyond its proper limits.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence مِن قَبْلُ ... كَانُوا places the group in prior time and predicates a settled condition of them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Priorness, temporal predication, and the emphatic second هُمْ turn an old community into an anterior precedent whose condition had become characteristic rather than momentary.

activation_trace.role: Priorness makes مِن قَبْلُ position this case ahead of the neighboring historical examples.
Being and temporal predication hold the two elatives as an established condition in time.
The station or residence image supports reading the group as having occupied a durable moral station.

changed_reading.before: مِن قَبْلُ merely dates Noah's people earlier than the others.
changed_reading.after: Their anteriority makes them a deep precedent, while كَانُوا presents maximal wrong and excess as their settled historical station.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired superlatives join ظ ل م, an image of wrong placement, to ط غ ي, an image of passing a limit, within a ق و م that can evoke upright order.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can be read as moral geometry: a community that should stand in even order instead dislocates things from their places and then exceeds the perimeter of measure.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and evenness provide the unrealized norm against which the people are measured.
Putting an act in the wrong concrete time or place supplies the displacement axis of injustice.
Crossing the proper bound supplies the second axis, excess beyond placement and proportion.

changed_reading.before: أَظْلَمَ and أَطْغَىٰ are two near-synonymous intensifiers of evil.
changed_reading.after: The pair is diagnostic rather than redundant: one names displacement or deprivation, the other uncontained expansion beyond measure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوْمَ names a social body, while أَطْغَىٰ carries a material image of a force that rises and overflows.
baseline_models.mechanism: A polity has supports by which it stands; here those supports become mechanisms of withholding until accumulated power behaves like a surge that escapes its channel. This is a systems reading, not merely a sum of private offenses.

activation_trace.role: Support, mainstay, and subsistence make the people legible as an organized system with sustaining structures.
Withholding rights describes how the system concentrates what its members or dependents are owed.
An overflowing, overwhelming force converts moral excess into a material model of institutional spillover.
The non-dominant mapped branch also supplies surging beyond bounds, keeping the material model independently anchored.

changed_reading.before: The verse ranks the intensity of many individual acts.
changed_reading.after: The verse can rank a whole social apparatus whose means of standing have become means of deprivation and overwhelming expansion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated ه و ي alternates inward desire with downward fall. Set beside the focus image of overflow, it yields a cycle in which appetite supplies direction, collective power rises past its channel, and the excess is answered by a fall.

activation_trace.role: Rising overflow supplies the upward and outward phase of the focus community's excess.
Falling into a depth opens the surah with the downward counter-motion to overflow.
The inclination of desire supplies an inward directional force that true speech does not follow.
Desire reappears as the pull followed by selves, making appetite available as a social driver.
The immediate post-focus fall turns vertical reversal into the consequence phase of the mechanism.

structural_cues: One root frames the surah's opening movement, the rejected source of speech, the desire behind unsupported worship, and the action immediately after the focus ayah.
The focus elative is followed without narrative pause by a downward action in 53:53.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire, fall, and overflowing excess; I infer that inward inclination feeds social overreach and that overreach is answered by descent, while the live alternative is a looser polysemous framing echo without a causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: أَطْغَىٰ is a static ranking of rebellion.
changed_reading.after: أَطْغَىٰ occupies the crest of a desire-rise-fall process: appetite acquires collective force, exceeds measure, and is spatially reversed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes deviation from a path from the focus pair of withholding and overstepping. Noah's people are therefore not described as merely lost; the superlatives mark active production of wrong after a guidance axis is available.

activation_trace.role: Withholding a right makes the focus diagnosis active and relational rather than merely directional.
Rebellious boundary crossing adds deliberate excess to the focus diagnosis.
Deviation from guidance supplies the less agentive path-loss category against which the focus pair differentiates itself.
Gentle indication toward the true road establishes the directional alternative to both wandering and active excess.

structural_cues: The opening denies path-deviation of the messenger, while 53:30 closes its epistemic unit by contrasting who strays with who is guided.
The focus does not reuse ض ل ل; it escalates to two agentive superlatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct path-loss, guidance, withholding, and overstep images; I infer a scale from misdirection to active social injury, while the alternative is that all four belong to parallel moral vocabulary without a scale.

changed_reading.before: The verse calls the ancient people maximally misguided.
changed_reading.after: The wording goes beyond misguidance: it portrays a community that actively blocks rights and forces itself beyond known bounds.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 53:17, exemplary sight neither bends away nor crosses its limit. The exact reuse of ط غ ي revises the focus from sheer behavioral violence to failed epistemic discipline: the community's social transgression may begin in seeing, claiming, or judging beyond what is given.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies boundary crossing as the shared predicate that can move from perception to collective conduct.
The eye's turning or fatigue supplies one perceptual failure that the witnessed vision avoids.
Literal eyesight fixes the domain in which non-deviation and non-excess are first modeled.
The negated overstep makes disciplined perception a direct inverse of the focus community's superlative excess.
The second mapped overstep branch confirms that the perceptual contrast survives the split-root resolution.

structural_cues: 53:17 places two negated failures around the subject البصر: it neither deviated nor transgressed.
53:52 converts the same ط غ ي root into a positive superlative predicated of a whole people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct lexical contrast between bounded sight and maximal communal overstep; I infer that epistemic self-restraint can scale into social justice and its failure into tyranny, while conduct-only and perception-only readings remain possible.

changed_reading.before: أَطْغَىٰ concerns only outward rebellion or domination.
changed_reading.after: أَطْغَىٰ also names a collective refusal of perceptual limits: claiming beyond evidence becomes one engine of outward domination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The defective, unjust division in 53:22 gives the focus ظلم a concrete distributive operation. Maximal wrong is not an atmospheric quality; it allocates shares asymmetrically and locates value where the allocators' own standard would reject it.

activation_trace.role: Wrong placement turns injustice into a failure to put shares, claims, or values where they belong.
Withholding a right supplies the deprivation produced by a skewed allocation.
Separating and assigning a share provides the concrete distributive procedure.
A deficient and unjust division names the distorted outcome that activates the focus's wrong-placement branch.

structural_cues: 53:21 stages an asymmetrical assignment, and 53:22 explicitly evaluates the resulting division.
The focus's comparative أَظْلَمَ later scales that distributive wrong to a communal maximum.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concrete unjust division and focus branches of misplacement and withholding; I generalize allocation from 53:22 into a model of communal injustice, while the alternative keeps the division local to its immediate polemic.

changed_reading.before: أَظْلَمَ is a broad charge of wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: أَظْلَمَ can diagnose a distributive order that assigns value selectively, misplaces shares, and deprives others of what is due.

context_deltas.mechanism: Names become socially visible labels without compelling warrant; supposition occupies the place of disclosed knowledge; a limited epistemic reach is treated as exhaustive. Read with the focus roots, this is an authority machine that withholds truth and installs boundary-crossing claims as public order.

activation_trace.role: Governance and maintenance allow the named people to be read as an order that reproduces and polices claims.
Withholding the right functions epistemically as blocking truth or warranted access.
False authority as a head of deviation turns unsupported claims into a governing center.
Naming as designation supplies labels that can circulate without supplying the reality or warrant they claim.
The non-dominant image of a visible identifying mark shows how a label becomes socially legible and repeatable.
Compelling proof supplies the missing authorization against which the labels are exposed.
Doubt and conjecture supply the unstable content that the authority machine promotes as knowledge.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic standard that conjecture fails to meet.
Reaching an endpoint makes their knowledge a bounded terminus that they wrongly treat as sufficient.

structural_cues: 53:23 joins inherited naming, absence of authorization, conjecture, desire, and the arrival of guidance in one causal-looking sequence.
53:28 denies knowledge and repeats conjecture, while 53:30 explicitly limits its reach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies labels, absent proof, conjecture, disclosed knowledge, and a reached limit; I infer a social mechanism that converts labels into authority and finite knowledge into total claims, while the live alternative treats these as separate critiques of worship and cognition.

changed_reading.before: Noah's people are remembered chiefly for behavioral disobedience.
changed_reading.after: Their maximal wrong and excess can also name an epistemic polity: it manufactures authorized-looking labels, suppresses warrant, and lets conjecture govern beyond its competence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby distinction between major wrongs and a small approach to wrongdoing, together with protective forgiveness and the ban on self-purification, prevents the focus superlatives from flattening every person and every lapse into one essence. They diagnose sustained collective extremity while leaving moral gradation live.

activation_trace.role: The group image permits a dominant corporate pattern without requiring identical status for every individual.
A superlative degree of overstepping marks sustained extremity at the collective level.
Approaching a small wrong supplies a low-intensity category distinct from entrenched maximal excess.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer preserves the possibility that wrongdoing need not become final identity.
Purity and rectitude supply the status people are forbidden to certify for themselves.

structural_cues: 53:32 distinguishes major offenses and indecencies from اللمم, then immediately forbids self-exonerating claims.
53:52 uses comparative-superlative forms of degree rather than an undifferentiated noun of identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit gradation, forgiveness, and a collective superlative; I infer that the focus ranks an entrenched social pattern without asserting uniform, immutable guilt for every member, while an aggregate historical judgment remains the alternative.

changed_reading.before: The double superlative essentializes every member of the people as equally and irredeemably worst.
changed_reading.after: The double superlative identifies the collective pattern's sustained extreme, while the surah's own moral scale preserves distinctions among persons, acts, and recoverable lapses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The corporate noun قَوْم does not create transferable guilt. The subsequent burden, effort, and recompense sequence nests individual accounts inside a collective historical pattern: systems can be judged corporately while each person's acquired action remains non-substitutable.

activation_trace.role: The group image supplies the corporate level of the focus judgment.
A heavy carried burden makes liability personal and explicitly resistant to transfer.
Work and acquisition locate the accountable input in each person's own activity.
Answering an act with its recompense closes the individual action-account loop.

structural_cues: 53:38 denies that one bearer carries another's burden.
53:39-41 repeatedly singularize effort, its visibility, and its full recompense before the text returns to destroyed peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a group predicate followed by non-transferable individual accounting; I infer two nested scales of judgment rather than a contradiction, while the alternative is that collective destruction and final individual recompense remain unrelated registers.

changed_reading.before: Calling the whole قوم most unjust assigns one undivided guilt to an undifferentiated mass.
changed_reading.after: The قوم names an emergent collective regime, but the regime does not erase the separate burden, effort, and recompense of each participant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusative قَوْمَ is coordinated into an already running destruction sequence. The governing act from 53:50 carries through 53:51 into the focus, after which overturning, casting down, and all-covering force continue it. The focus is therefore a causally loaded segment of one cascade, not a detached historical ranking.

activation_trace.role: The people form the coordinated human object inserted into the sequence.
Priorness marks this coordinated object as the deepest historical precedent in the cascade.
Falling into destruction supplies the governing action that the reader carries across the coordination.
Sparing or leaving alive is negated, intensifying the completeness of the inherited destruction frame.
Turning a thing from its orientation extends the sequence through reversal immediately after the focus.
Casting into a depth gives the post-focus destruction a downward vector.
An encompassing cover supplies the terminal, totalizing phase of the cascade.

structural_cues: 53:50 begins with an explicit causative destruction verb; 53:51 and the accusative وَقَوْمَ in 53:52 continue its object chain.
53:53-54 resume explicit destructive motions, enclosing the focus between cause and consequence language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the accusative coordination and the surrounding destruction verbs; I carry the governing action of 53:50 across the ellipsis into 53:52, while the alternative parses each item as a terser independent clause inside the same destruction catalogue.

changed_reading.before: 53:52 pauses the destruction list to offer a parenthetical moral comparison.
changed_reading.after: 53:52 is grammatically inside the destruction cascade: its superlatives function as the causal characterization of the earliest coordinated people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ancient مِن قَبْلُ case is immediately converted into a warning of the first warnings, then placed beside an event drawing near with no one able to uncover or remove it. Remote precedent and approaching consequence fold together, making the focus address the present disputant rather than merely archive the past.

activation_trace.role: Priorness supplies the distant historical pole that the later warning makes present.
Denial through contentious disputation identifies the present response that the old precedent confronts.
A warning that awakens caution turns the destruction account into prospective address.
Beginning and precedence align the current warning with an earlier warning lineage.
Drawing near supplies the approaching temporal pole that collapses distance from the ancient case.
Lifting a cover supplies the unavailable removal, making the approaching consequence inescapable.

structural_cues: The sequence moves directly from destroyed peoples to present disputation, warning, nearness, and the absence of any remover.
The focus's مِن قَبْلُ and 53:56's الْأُولَىٰ repeat precedence language on opposite sides of the warning pivot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies past precedence, present denial, warning, and nearness; I infer that the old case is being reactivated as a near future-facing threat, while the alternative keeps historical recollection and eschatological warning as adjacent but separate moves.

changed_reading.before: مِن قَبْلُ consigns Noah's people to remote history.
changed_reading.after: Their priority makes them a reusable warning-pattern: the most distant case is brought nearest to the present audience as consequence approaches.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending turns ethical height into bodily posture. Self-magnification and raised-headed standing echo the focus images of an upright people occupying a high outcrop; prostration and submissive worship then reverse that elevation into deliberate lowering.

activation_trace.role: Standing upright supplies the bodily posture latent in the collective noun's root.
A smooth raised rock or high place spatializes transgressive self-elevation.
Self-magnification supplies the affective posture behind refusing the warning.
Raising the head and standing makes elevated resistance bodily visible.
Bowing the head supplies the exact bodily inversion of raised-headed standing.
Submissive obedience converts the physical lowering into an ethical alternative to overreach.

structural_cues: 53:59-61 move through incredulous reaction and heedless bearing before 53:62 issues two bodily and devotional imperatives.
The final imperative supplies the audience-level reversal of the focus people's settled posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-magnification, raised-head standing, bowing, and submissive worship; I map moral overreach onto bodily height and the final commands onto its correction, while the alternative reads the posture sequence as exhortation unrelated to the ancient قوم.

changed_reading.before: The focus labels a past people's invisible moral condition.
changed_reading.after: The focus also prepares a bodily choice for the present audience: remain raised in self-exceeding resistance, or reverse the posture through prostration and service.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets a moral elative carry a material flood-like image. It remains anchored in both mapped ط غ ي overflow branches, in the naming of Noah within the focus, and in the following all-covering force; downstream prose should call it a hydraulic resonance, not claim that أَطْغَىٰ literally means flood or that the packet itself states the historical medium.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly joins Noah's name to أَطْغَىٰ, whose two mapped inventories both preserve water surging beyond measure.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing water and overwhelming force give the moral excess a hydraulic material analogue.
The non-dominant mapped root independently preserves surging water as a second anchor for the resonance.
An encompassing cover supplies a neighboring image of consequence that spreads over its object.

changed_reading.before: Transgression and punishment belong to separate semantic domains.
changed_reading.after: The people's moral excess can be heard as becoming materially like an overflow: the form of their transgression anticipates the form of overwhelming consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a specialized non-dominant sense of طغي as a people's voice or noise. It remains unusually anchored by the literal co-presence of قَوْم and أَطْغَىٰ in the focus and by the closing sequence of renewed discourse and heedless diversion; downstream prose must present it as a faint acoustic undertone, never as the lexical translation of أَطْغَىٰ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَوْمَ and أَطْغَىٰ occur in one clause, closely matching the non-dominant branch image in which the people's طغي is their noise.

activation_trace.role: The human group supplies the collective whose acoustic behavior the rare branch names.
The specialized image of a people's voice or noise activates an acoustic layer inside the superlative.
Speech renewed as report supplies the discourse that communal noise can refuse to hear.
Absorption in diversion and heedlessness supplies the listening failure sustained by that noise.

changed_reading.before: أَطْغَىٰ marks only the degree of the people's rebellion.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the lexical field, their maximal excess also sounds like communal noise that fills the channel in which warning should be heard.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatializes the ordinary temporal مِن قَبْلُ through the root's face-to-face branch. It remains anchored in the focus word and gains force when the approaching event follows; downstream prose should call this rhetorical staging of precedent, not replace the normal temporal sense of قَبْلُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِن قَبْلُ is temporally clear, but its root inventory also permits the old community to be imagined as placed facing the current audience.

activation_trace.role: Facing one thing toward another turns temporal precedent into a rhetorical face-to-face placement.
The people supply the historical body staged before the audience.
Drawing near collapses the distance that would otherwise keep the prior people safely behind the present.

changed_reading.before: The people of Noah stand behind the audience in remote chronological time.
changed_reading.after: Their very priority lets the discourse set them before the audience as a confronting precedent whose consequence is drawing near.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates valuation and equal-measure branches distant from the surface noun قَوْم. It remains anchored by the focus's paired comparatives and grievance branch, then by explicit division and act-for-recompense context; downstream prose should frame it as an accounting analogy, not derive the ordinary meaning of قوم from price or weight.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired superlatives perform an appraisal of a قوم, while distant ق و م branches supply valuation and equal measure and ظ ل م supplies the claim for redress.

activation_trace.role: Value and appraisal turn the paired superlatives into a figurative assessment of the community.
Equal weight and even measure supply the norm against which that assessment is made.
A grievance seeking redress supplies the unsettled liability entered into the figurative ledger.
Assigning shares provides the distributive side of the accounting analogy.
The deficient unjust division shows the ledger already distorted by its human assessors.
Matching action with recompense supplies the eventual exact settlement of the distorted account.

changed_reading.before: The two elatives are only emotive intensifiers.
changed_reading.after: They can also sound like a measured verdict in a moral ledger: a community that corrupted shares is itself appraised before exact recompense.

strongest_changes: The paired elatives separate inward deprivation from outward boundary crossing and expose a corporate mechanism rather than redundant wickedness.
The exact 53:17 contrast makes أَطْغَىٰ an epistemic as well as political failure: disciplined sight does not exceed what it is given.
The naming, proof, conjecture, and limited-knowledge sequence activates a model of unsupported labels becoming social authority.
Individual burden and recompense revise the corporate judgment into nested scales rather than collective transfer of guilt.
The surrounding syntax places 53:52 inside a destruction cascade and then converts remote precedent into a near warning.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a hinge where several readings remain simultaneously live: social system, moral geometry, epistemic overreach, hydraulic overflow, temporal precedent, and a posture awaiting reversal. The split ط غ ي mapping was especially productive, preserving both the strong overflow model and the rare collective-noise undertone without forcing either into the ordinary gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from desire to collective excess is abductive; repeated ه و ي may instead provide non-causal thematic framing.
The epistemic reading of أَطْغَىٰ is strongly activated by 53:17 but need not displace its behavioral and political senses.
The hydraulic Noah resonance uses a branch-backed image plus the focus name, but its historical association is reader-supplied and should remain qualified.
The posture, acoustic, facing, and valuation readings are deliberately form-distant exploratory layers, not replacement translations.
The corporate judgment can describe an aggregate regime without revealing how exceptions among its individual members are distributed.
